items:
Castle of Dreams -

Let your vacation dreams come true in this quaint "castle" by the sea. Nestled among the sandy pines on a quiet street in popular Grayton Beach, this 3 bedroom, 2 bath cottage comfortably sleeps 8, with two queen bedrooms, and a third bedroom with two sets of twin bunks.

Enjoy the gulf breezes year round while lounging in an Adirondack chair or dining al fresco on the large screened in porch. The open floor plan greets guests as they enter, allowing each guest space for their favorite activities. After a day at the beach, leave the sand and suntan oil outside with the use of the outdoor hot/cold shower. The chef friendly kitchen with granite countertops and down draft range offers guests a comfortable and convenient area to prepare memorable meals.

Come spend your special vacation in ‘Castle of Dreams’. You’ll want to come back year after year and make this charming cottage your home away from home, a perfect spot for a private getaway.

First Floor: Living Room with Screened Porch Access, Dining, Kitchen, Queen Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bedroom, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Twin Bunks, Laundry.

*Note – This property may have date restrictions that apply. All reservations submitted online are a request until receiving an email confirmation from Ocean Reef Resorts. For more details, please review our Minimum Night Stay under Rental Policies. An e-signed rental agreement is required prior to arrival.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Grayton Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting.
